content.value: Suppose, you and your friend are playing a game where there are $\cdot _ { k } ,$ spots. Each spot has balls of same color. Each of you simultaneously picks a (single) ball from each spot and approach forward. You start from the first spot and your friend from the last spot to the first spot. Determine using TM with storage if both of you have chosen balls of same color in same sequence when you meet at the middle spot.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
